name: Hand Torch
description: A plastic torch with a rubber grip. It throws a hard white circle and eats cells doing it.

name: Penlight
description: A pen-sized torch off a nurse's lanyard. Barely a light, and it goes on for days.

name: Steel Torch
description: A long steel-bodied torch, heavy enough to be a decision. Bright, and it lasts a night.

name: Headlamp
description: An elastic band with a lamp on the front. It is not the brightest thing you can carry, and it is the only one that leaves both hands free.

name: Miner's Lamp
description: A helmet lamp off an industrial rack, wired to a belt cell. It looks wherever you look.

name: Clip Light
description: A hobbyist's lamp that clips to a pair of glasses. A reading light, and it will read a lock for you.

name: Glowstick
description: A plastic tube of cold green light. Snap it and there is no taking it back.

name: Road Flare
description: A highway flare, red and furious. It lights the whole street for a little while and tells the whole street about it.

name: Camping Lantern
description: A gas lantern with a fragile mantle. It hisses, it is bright, and it wants a bottle.

name: Storm Lantern
description: A squat oil lantern built to stay lit in weather. Dim, patient, and thirsty for very little.

name: Tallow Candle
description: A fat household candle that smells faintly of the kitchen. It burns a long while and it burns away.

name: Lighter
description: A disposable lighter, half full. The worst light in the world and better than none.

name: Work Light
description: A site lamp on a folding frame, plumbed to a gas bottle. Nobody carries this lit; you stand it somewhere and it owns the yard.

name: Lamp Oil
description: A flask of clear lamp oil. It fills a lantern and it is the reason the lantern was worth carrying.

name: Propane Cylinder
description: A blue camping bottle, still heavy. Gas for a lantern, or for the thing lighting the yard.
